items.title: 53566_Benjamin F.
items.q: I told you we went to work in Watts for Baron Long where we'd play for Rudolph Valentino.

ctx.x: Yeah. We played down there, and they had ice skating rink, and they had two shows a night, and we played for the show and all of the different acts and things. Then when we left there, we came to Los Angeles, and I told you we went to work in Watts for Baron Long where we'd play for Rudolph Valentino.
